item.title: 🔴 Hotel Wi-Fi attacks use custom malware to breach Microsoft 365 accounts
item.description:
Why this matters: Nation-state threat actor — elevated persistence and lateral movement risk.
Microsoft has linked a global campaign targeting hospitality Wi-Fi networks to the Russian threat actor Midnight Blizzard, also known as APT29. [...]
